verdict.rationale: Salv documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI definition, OAuth2 auth and a sandbox environment. Nothing in the evidence describes API versioning, version identifiers in endpoints, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The 'scenario version' mention refers to monitoring rule versions, not API versions, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
